title: Baby-name coverage misses core cohorts
finding: The public baby-name data covers Czechia only and spans 2010–2023, so it cannot support names features for the older Czech and Ukrainian cohorts central to the product.

evidence.detail: The committed public records begin in 2010 and end in 2023.
The loader has no Ukrainian public dataset counterpart.

proposedAction: Owner may commission a sourced pre-2010 Czech and Ukrainian names dataset; until then, the venture treats names as a research-dependent gap.
